blocks.text: When God appears to Solomon in a dream at Gibeon and offers him whatever he desires, Solomon requests an understanding heart to judge his people rather than long life, wealth, or the destruction of his enemies. Solomon acknowledges his inexperience—describing himself as a little child who does not yet know how to lead—and asks for divine assistance in discerning between good and evil. God approves of this request and grants Solomon wisdom and understanding heart unmatched by any before him.
